title: cotula discolor
intro: Cotula discolor, commonly known as Yellow Buttons or Buttercups, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cotula discolor include its ability to soothe and calm the body, reduce fever, and relieve respiratory congestion, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
